## Pull request overview Adds three new documentation guides to round out v1 user-facing docs around configuration selection, diagnostics, and the import-driven `otel.instrumentation.go` mechanism, plus cross-links from existing docs/README to improve discoverability. **Changes:** - Added new guides: configuration/fine-tuning, troubleshooting, and external configuration protocol reference. - Documented rule-source precedence, selectors (`target`/`version`/`where.file`), and the external tool-file discovery/resolution model. - Added cross-links in README + existing docs to connect setup, limitations, rules loading, and troubleshooting. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | README.md | Adds the three new docs to the documentation index. | | docs/configuration.md | New guide for rule-source precedence and practical scoping/tuning patterns. | | docs/troubleshooting.md | New diagnostic guide covering “nothing got instrumented”, debug/stats, artifacts, and common errors. | | docs/external-configuration.md | New protocol/spec reference for `otel.instrumentation.go` / `otelc.tool.go` resolution and precedence. | | docs/rules.md | Adds “see also” links to the new configuration and external configuration guides. | | docs/instrument-guide.md | Adds a pointer from limitations to troubleshooting. |
